title: POV: NIGHT RIDE
UNDER A PIZZA MOON
caption: Funky nu-disco house at 122 BPM, four-on-the-floor kick, slap bass groove, disco strings, wah guitar chops, vocoder ad-libs, cowbell, playful charismatic male pop vocal, big catchy sing-along chorus, late-night city party energy, clean modern mix
lyrics:
[Intro - house beat]

[Verse 1]
Midnight in the city and the pizza's on the moon
Taxi full of pigeons singing out of tune
Neon on the windows flashing pink and blue
Hold on to your noodles, we are coming through

[Chorus]
Up to the rooftop, down to the street
Pizza moon is shining on my dancing feet
Upside down and the city goes round
Pizza moon, never coming down

[Verse 2]
Grandma on a scooter doing ninety in the rain
Dancing with a robot on a disco train
Hot dog in a tuxedo waving from the bar
Everybody's singing, we're a pizza star

[Chorus]
Up to the rooftop, down to the street
Pizza moon is shining on my dancing feet
Upside down and the city goes round
Pizza moon, never coming down

[Outro - instrumental]

picked.why: Whisper small.en matched 112/123 lyric tokens; seed 777 skipped most of the chorus and verse 2 (46/123)
